test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 8(1)/(2) years at the rate of 3.2% per annum is Rs. 2,550. What will be the amount payable on the same sum at the rate of 9.6% per annum simple interest in 5(4)/(5) years?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective rate for first case = 3.2% × 8.5 = 27.2%

**Principal (P)** = (2550 ÷ 27.2) × 100 = ₹9,375

New effective interest rate = 9.6% × 5.8 = 55.68%

New **Simple Interest** = 9375 × 55.68% = ₹5,220

**Total Amount** = Principal + New Interest = 9375 + 5220 = ₹14,595

**∴ The correct answer is ₹14,595.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Case 1: **Simple Interest (SI₁)** = ₹2,550, **Rate (R₁)** = 3.2% p.a., **Time (T₁)** = 8.5 years

Case 2: **Rate (R₂)** = 9.6% p.a., **Time (T₂)** = 5.8 years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f66e8636fca3be2789a4894e420d10102c418c2bcd1470bcb04d90e1d7f973f.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + SI

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2550 = (P × 3.2 × 8.5) / 100

⇒ 2550 × 100 = P × 27.2

⇒ P = 255000 / 27.2 = ₹9,375

⇒ New **Simple Interest (SI₂)** = (9375 × 9.6 × 5.8) / 100

⇒ SI₂ = (9375 × 55.68) / 100 = ₹5,220

⇒ **Payable Amount** = P + SI₂ = 9375 + 5220 = ₹14,595

**∴ The correct answer is ₹14,595.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Interest

In **Simple Interest**, the total interest percentage over multiple years is simply the product of the annual rate and the number of years (R × T).

Compound Interest Formula

Unlike SI, **Compound Interest** is calculated on the accumulated amount: A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ, where n is the number of compounding periods.

Difference between SI and CI

For a period of 2 years, the difference between CI and SI is given by the formula: Difference = P(r/100)².
